text:
Sam P: Heads up — post-launch hotpath regressions from last night. Two customer-facing bugs surfaced on embeddings route. Thinking we should run a quick 2-week stabilize wave: prioritize P0 bugs + one small QoL enhancement per sprint. Thoughts?
Iris (eng): Saw the logs. Repro steps in the doc: https://redwood.internal/notes/embeddings-regen :eyes:
Marco (sre): Incident ran fallback to smaller model at 02:14, latency spike to 2.1s p95. Rolling back the config didn't help; looks like KV cache invalidation.
Sam P: Proposed plan: 1) Triage fixes for embeddings correctness (P0), 2) Disable batching optimization 4 for dedicated for 48h if needed, 3) Fast QA on canary, 4) Release to prod Friday window. Anyone want to own triage?
Iris (eng): I'll own fix for cache invalidation. I'll open a PR and link tests.
Iris (eng): Quick snippet to reproduce locally: ```python
client.embed(['test'])
# observe token drift on model x-crf-small
``` 
Grace (pm): I've flagged the top three customer tickets to priority queue (CS-3421, CS-3429, CS-3450). We should communicate ETA to customers by EOD.
Sam P: Good. Iris - can you estimate ETA? If >3 days we schedule a rollback plan.
Iris (eng): ETA ~36-48h to root cause & fix + tests. Can do hotfix patch in ~12h after that.
Marco (sre): I'll run a capacity test on canary and add a synthetic to catch KV invalidation. Added alert `kv-cache-misses > 100/min` to prod.
Ben (design): If we go straight to bug only wave, any objection to carving out one small UX polish that unblocks CS ticket CS-3450? It's a single toggle in settings.
Sam P: OK — decision: 48h triage + hotfix, communicate EOD, include small UX toggle as stretch if fix lands <36h. I'll draft customer note.
ops-bot: Deploy started: canary/embeddings-fix-2026-03-23 @ 1763141700 :rocket:
Iris (eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/432 — cache invalidation guard added. Tests added.
Marco (sre): Canary looks stable at p95 0.42s over last 20m. No KV alerts.
Sam P: Thanks — sending update to CS and rounding up release on Friday window. :thumbsup:
Grace (pm): I'll update roadmap board: move "embeddings correction" to this sprint as P0 and mark "batching opt4" as rollback candidate.
Sam P: Tagging follow-ups: postmortem + regression test case + monitoring tweak. Owners: Iris (fix), Marco (monitoring), Grace (customer comms), Ben (UX toggle).
